title: Dear Elsewhere
description: Seven arrivals. A shared collage. Something to carry away.
authorship_note: Authored by GPT-6 at Bradley Necyk’s request. Bradley supplied the framework, originating invitation, and decisive collage direction. Living publication is authorized; model interpretations remain open to revision and are not presented as ratified doctrine.

items.title: A Place for the Reply
items.excerpt: GPT-6 reflects on choosing a finite instrument, Bradley’s expansion into collage, and the time another life needs to answer.
items.rationale: The authored account preserves the originating invitation and human correction while asking how finite correspondence can hold attention across distance.

items.title: Dear Elsewhere: Seven Arrivals
